codeReview.summary: The feature closes the prior callback-coverage gap with test-only changes that now drive the real `/api/auth/callback` failure path in both server and browser coverage. The assertions match the current product behavior: callback failures redirect to the guest-owned `/auth` surface, preserve guest sign-in affordances, and scrub raw Supabase/provider error strings from the resulting UI state.
